postgres.description: PostgreSQL database (read-only). Tables: users(id, email, country, plan, created_at), bugs(id like 'BUG-101', title, severity critical|high|medium|low, status open|in_progress|closed, component, reported_at, fixed_in_commit), deployments(id, service, version, status success|failed|rolled_back, deployed_at). Run SQL SELECTs, inspect schema, query plans, locks, table sizes.

shell.description: Sandboxed OS diagnostics. Files: logs/app.log, logs/worker.log (lines reference bug ids like BUG-101), config/app.yaml. Read and grep files, disk usage, processes, allow-listed read-only commands.

github.description: GitHub (official github-mcp-server, read-only): repositories, commits, files, branches, issues, pull requests, releases, Actions workflow runs.
